newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-New South Wales Australia has good rain-govt.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-New South Wales Australia has good rain-govt.

text.p: Beneficial February rains over much of the north and western divisions of the Australian state of New South Wales resulted in a decrease in drought-declared areas for March, Agriculture Minister Richard Amery said.
Summer rains resulting from cyclones further north had good follow-up rains which further promoted pasture growth, he said in a statement.
A total of 19 percent of the state was drought-declared in March, down from 23 percent in February.
The northern tablelands had one of the best seasons for many years and prospects for winter were excellent, he said.
